GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly and missed the start, Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Up rounding turn, hooked Wide Straightening Up and widest at 200m, Made Ground to the line.
